# Security policy

Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue, discussion, or pull request. Use **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability** in this repository to send a private report through GitHub.

Useful reports include vulnerabilities affecting authentication, Supabase access control, timetable privacy, calendar file parsing, or account and cloud-data deletion. Include clear reproduction steps and the least sensitive test data needed to demonstrate the issue.

Do not include credentials, access tokens, or real student timetable data. Use synthetic data and redact personal information.

Gapwise is a student-maintained project. Reports will be reviewed as capacity permits, so response times may vary. No particular response or remediation timeline is guaranteed.
